title: Nano wallet
description: Nano-wallet is a digital payment protocol designed to be accessible and lightweight, with a focus on removing inefficiencies present in other cryptocurrencies. With ultrafast transactions and zero fees on a secure, green and decentralised network, this makes Nano ideal for everyday transactions. This container is a simple nginx wrapper for the light wallet located here. You will need to pass a valid Rpc host when accessing this container.
